receipt.public_excerpt:
The Office of Defects Investigation (ODI) has received 354 complaints alleging unexpected brake activation in
2021-2022 Tesla Model 3 and Model Y vehicles.

evidence_items.explanation: The investigation documents a substantial number of complaints received by its opening date. It does not establish whether rare inputs, learned representations, planning defects, or another mechanism caused the reported behavior.
